how.title: From a sentence to a listed capsule
how.lead: Four steps. Two of them are yours, and nothing moves on without your yes.

steps.title: Set the direction
steps.body: Write the brief the way you'd brief a studio: the mood, the references, who it's for. One sentence works; more detail gets closer.
steps.detail: “Washed botanical line drawings, spring, for people who garden on balconies.”

steps.title: Research and drafts
steps.body: wovain reads what your audience is into and what is moving this week, then drafts graphics for each idea, sized and checked for print.
steps.detail: Every idea shows its sources and a print check.

steps.title: Edit and approve
steps.body: Approve the pieces you'd put your name on. Reject one with a note, such as “heavier type, lose the leaves”, and wovain draws another round.
steps.detail: Nothing is listed without your approval.

steps.title: List and stage
steps.body: Approved designs become products on your Fourthwall shop, on real blanks, priced from their base cost. wovain writes ads from several angles and builds a Meta campaign around them.
steps.detail: Products start hidden. The campaign starts paused.

connectors.title: Works inside the accounts you already run
connectors.lead: Connect each one with its own sign-in. The products, artwork and ads stay in your accounts, and you can disconnect at any time.

fourthwall.body: Products are created on real blanks in your shop. Fourthwall prints, ships and runs checkout.

fal.body: Draws the graphics for each idea on your fal account, at print resolution.

meta.body: The campaign is built in your ad account, created paused, with the daily budget you set.

outcomes.title: Studio time back, margins intact
outcomes.lead: wovain takes on the production chores around a drop, so your time goes to the work only you can do.

items.title: One flow, brief to listing
items.body: Research, drafts, listings and ads happen in one place, in order, with your approval between them.

items.title: Prices that hold
items.body: Every price starts from the blank's real base cost and keeps at least $10 profit and a 30% margin after card fees, sales tax and a refund reserve.

items.title: Nothing spends by itself
items.body: Campaigns are created paused, with a daily budget from $1 to $500. You turn them on in Meta.

items.title: Ads with more than one idea
items.body: Each product gets several ads written from different angles, so you can see which one your audience answers.

items.title: Autopilot, when you want it
items.body: Turn it on and wovain makes the approval calls itself, within the same price floor and budget, and records why.

items.title: Your work stays yours
items.body: You own your briefs and the designs you approve. Products, artwork and ads sit in your own accounts.

faqSection.title: Before you start
faqSection.lead: Short answers. The docs go further.

faq.question: Who is wovain for?
faq.answer: Independent designers and small labels who sell graphic pieces through print-on-demand: tees, sweatshirts, totes and prints on Fourthwall.

faq.question: Will it make my label look generic?
faq.answer: You set the direction and approve every piece. Reject a design with a note and wovain draws another round. Nothing is listed without your yes.

faq.question: Will wovain spend money on ads by itself?
faq.answer: No. Every campaign is created paused, at the daily budget you choose, from $1 to $500. Spend starts only when you turn it on in Meta Ads Manager.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: A Fourthwall shop for the products, a fal account for the artwork and a Meta ad account for the campaign. You connect each one with its own sign-in after you create your account.

faq.question: How are prices set?
faq.answer: From the blank's real base cost on Fourthwall: at least $10 profit and a 30% margin, after card fees, sales tax and a refund reserve, rounded up to a whole dollar. You can change any price later in Fourthwall.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: wovain's plans are on the pricing page. Production is paid from each sale through Fourthwall, artwork is billed by fal and ad spend by Meta, each to your own account.

faq.question: Can I use it in ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Yes. wovain is also an app in ChatGPT, with the same steps and approvals. The docs explain how to add it.

faq.question: Who owns the designs?
faq.answer: You own your briefs and the designs you approve. wovain screens drafts for names and trademarks, but you stay responsible for what you publish.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We keep as little as we can, and we never sell data.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, email and password hash for your account; the briefs you write; and the runs, designs and products wovain makes for you.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use PostHog, hosted in the US, to learn how people find and use wovain: the pages you visit, what you click, page speed, the site's language and your country. Your country comes from your IP address, which isn't kept, and the page checks whether an automated browser is driving it, so bots aren't counted as visitors. Until you accept, it runs without cookies or browser storage, so it can't recognize you across visits or record replays. If you accept, or where the law doesn't require asking first, it stores an ID in your browser and records session replays, with everything you type and your account details hidden. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings at the bottom of the page, and a Global Privacy Control signal from your browser counts as a no. Once you sign in, these events are tied to your account's id, never your email.
privacy.connectionsBody: When you connect Fourthwall, Meta or fal, we store the access they grant so wovain can act for you. You can disconnect any of them at any time from Connections.
privacy.processorsBody: Briefs and designs are sent to the services that do the work: Nebius, Qloo, Tavily, fal, Fourthwall and Meta. Each handles data under its own policy.
privacy.deleteBody: Email privacy@wovain.com from your account's address and we delete your account, runs and stored connections within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: By using wovain you agree to these terms.
terms.useBody: wovain is provided as is, without warranty. Features may change or stop.
terms.contentBody: You own your briefs and the designs you approve. You are responsible for making sure what you publish does not infringe anyone's rights; wovain screens for trademarks but cannot guarantee it.
terms.spendBody: Campaigns are created paused. Any ad spend starts only when you turn a campaign on in Meta, and it is billed by Meta to your ad account.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms go to hello@wovain.com.
